findings.text: Slice modification during range loop skips elements: removing ExpectedCalls[i] shifts remaining elements down but the loop increments i, so if multiple matching calls exist (e.g., [A,B,B] unset B), only the first match is removed and subsequent matches are skipped, leaving stale expectations.

0.reason: The finding identifies the same root cause: Unset mutates ExpectedCalls during a range loop using append(slice[:i], slice[i+1:]...), which shifts elements and causes the loop to skip subsequent matches.
